name: auto-research
description: Can you see what the AI did, and is it still your research? A stage-aware research operating system: durable .research-os state via research_os.py, capability registry with per-host provider chains, first-class blockers, gate loop-backs, autonomous loop, template-first figure routing with a versioned figure library, two-stage visual contracts, anti-amnesia index (versions / ammo depot / snapshots), a research map and sourced taste rules. Dual-host package shared with Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: See what the AI did to your research, and keep it yours.
interface.longDescription: Routes research through only the phase skills needed now. All state I/O goes through scripts/research_os.py (validate-before-write, atomic, v1-migratable). Capabilities are probed against docs/capability-registry.json per host and degrade loudly or raise blockers instead of silently skipping. The pilot enforces gate loop-backs; research-loop drives autonomous multi-tick progression with wakeups and stop conditions. A research map shows what changed since you last looked, and a taste rules keep your standards in your own words.
defaultPrompt: Use $auto-research:pilot to assess this project and route the next research phase.
Use $auto-research:pilot to resume this paper and close its highest-risk gap.
Use $auto-research:research-loop to advance this project autonomously with state ticks.
